name: Client Call
description: Capture a client's goals, feedback, agreements, and follow-up commitments.

sections.title: Client Goals
sections.instruction: Summarize the client's stated goals, current situation, and measures of success. Separate explicit requests from assumptions.

sections.title: Needs and Feedback
sections.instruction: List questions, constraints, concerns, and feedback raised by the client. Preserve any stated priorities.

sections.title: Agreements
sections.instruction: List agreed scope, deliverables, timing, and commercial points only when discussed. Identify unresolved proposals as pending.

sections.title: Follow-up
sections.instruction: List commitments with the responsible person and deadline when stated. Include open questions and the next contact or meeting if agreed.
